## About
Prime Collision Repair is a locally owned body shop on Canton Road in Marietta. Our owner, Matt Jackson, was born and raised in Woodstock, GA, and started working on cars at an early age. He began Prime with a small crew and grew it into a team of experienced autobody experts.
We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family. Integrity matters in this business, and we don't take that lightly. Customers, employees, vendors and family all play a part in getting vehicles back on the road safely.
Our shop holds I-CAR Gold Class certification, and our technicians are certified in aluminum vehicles, electric vehicles, airbag and safety systems, and collision avoidance systems. We keep our computer aided manufacturers guides updated every month and follow each vehicle's own repair procedures line by line.
We're rated 4.6 on Google from 216 reviews. One customer said we kept her updated through the whole process, and another wrote that Brian took the time to review her company van and work out a plan to fix it.

## Services
- Full Collision Repair: Complete repair after an accident, brought back to your manufacturer's specifications.
- Aluminum Repair Certified: Our technicians are certified in servicing aluminum vehicles.
- Complete Safety Analysis: A full check of your vehicle's safety systems, because vehicle safety is key.
- Complete Computer Diagnostics: Diagnostics backed by computer aided manufacturers guides that we keep updated every month.
- Lazer Frame Repair: Frame repair aimed at keeping the structural integrity of your vehicle the way it should be.
- Steering and Suspension: Steering and suspension work for all vehicle makes and models.
- Electric Vehicle Repair: Repair for electric vehicles, following the manufacturer's own repair procedures.
- Collision Avoidance System Repair: Repair for the collision avoidance systems on today's vehicles, so their safety is never in question.

## FAQ
Q: Do I have to use the shop my insurance company picks?
A: No. Insurance companies will work with any shop, so the choice is yours to make for your vehicle.

Q: Can you handle my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We have strong partnerships with all of the major insurance companies and can handle your claim.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All makes and models. Our team trains on current repair procedures for every major automobile manufacturer.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., and closed on weekends.

Q: When will I hear back if I send a message?
A: If a reply is needed, you'll hear back within 48-72 hours. For anything sooner, give us a call.
